integrity: The proof is independently reconstructible from the cited rank-stratum geometry, skew-block normal form and adjunction. Exact algebraic checks supplement rather than replace the generic proof. The 1984 Harris–Tu full text was not retrievable; priority risk is explicitly disclosed.
scientific_limitations: General complex linear systems only; degree 84 quoted from Bolognesi–Ciliberto–Verra and Harris–Tu, not novel. No assertion for special systems, positive characteristic, Hodge numbers of the resolution, or unindexed prior literature.
title: The genus-169 singular curve and Grassmannian resolution of a general Pfaffian quartic
